define_boson_operator.note: Defines boson creation/annihilation operators name(i) and name'(i) in Main scope.

define_fermion_operator.note: Defines fermion operators name(i) and name'(i) in Main scope.

define_spin_operator.note: Defines SU(2) spin operators Sx, Sy, Sz on a lattice site. S+/S- can be defined manually as Sx+i*Sy and Sx-i*Sy to avoid @tlsxyz/@tlspm mixing issues in normal_form.

define_scalar_parameter.note: Registers a symbol as a commuting scalar parameter (c-number) in the notebook context. No Julia declaration is needed; scalars commute with everything by default.

define_vector.note: Registers a symbol as a vector quantity in the notebook context.

define_matrix.note: Registers a symbol as a matrix quantity in the notebook context.

define_tensor.note: Registers a symbol as a tensor quantity in the notebook context.

commutator.note: [A, B] = AB - BA, normal-ordered via CCR. _nb_eval_site_deltas evaluates δ(i,j)=0 for distinct concrete site labels.

anticommutator.note: {A, B} = AB + BA, normal-ordered. _nb_eval_site_deltas evaluates δ(i,j)=0 for distinct concrete site labels.

normal_order.note: Normal-orders a QuantumAlgebra expression. _nb_eval_site_deltas evaluates δ(i,j)=0 for distinct concrete site labels.

vacuum_expectation.note: <0|expr|0>. Computed as the operator-free part of the normal-ordered QuExpr via _nb_vac_expect (QuantumAlgebra's vacExpVal throws on symbolic scalar coefficients). δ cleanup drops sign-partner/integer deltas. Non-QuExpr results pass through unchanged.

heisenberg_equation.note: dA/dt = i[H, A] in natural units, reduced to normal form. _nb_eval_site_deltas evaluates δ(i,j)=0 for distinct concrete site labels.

simplify.note: Algebraic simplification (Symbolics.simplify also applies trig identities).

trig_simplify.note: Symbolics.simplify applies sin^2+cos^2=1, so trig_simplify maps to the same call. Keeps the 三角簡約 keyword backend-agnostic. NOTE: weaker than Maxima trigsimp on nested 3-D cases (may leave sin^2+cos^2 of a second angle).

factor.note: Symbolic factoring is not available in Symbolics.jl; falls back to simplify+expand.

differentiate.note: Symbolic differentiation using Symbolics.jl; _nb_differentiate applies Differential(var) order times.

integrate_definite.template: begin; _integ_, _err_, _solved_ = integrate({expr}, {var}); substitute(_integ_, Dict({var} => ({upper}))) - substitute(_integ_, Dict({var} => ({lower}))); end
integrate_definite.note: Definite integral via SymbolicNumericIntegration + endpoint substitution.

taylor_expand.note: Taylor/Maclaurin series expansion to given order around var=point (point is currently ignored; use substitute after if needed).

to_latex.note: Returns the LaTeX string for the expression.

multiply_expressions.note: Non-commutative product; order matters for quantum operators.

combine_expressions.note: Combines two expressions with the given operator (+, -, *, /).

matrix_multiply.note: Matrix product (Julia uses * for matrix multiplication).

diagonalize.note: Modal matrix P (eigenvectors as columns); eigvecs already returns it.

diagonal_matrix.note: Diagonal matrix D of the eigenvalues.

solve_equation.note: single-equation solve. build_command intercept uses full eq string.

operator_taylor_expand.note: f(H) ≈ Σ a_k H^k. func=scalar function of var, op=operator QuExpr, var=dummy variable.

extract_order.note: Extract coefficient of var^order from polynomial expression.

truncate_series.note: Keep only terms up to var^order, drop higher-order terms.

solve_system.note: System solve via Symbolics.solve_for([...], [...]). build_command builds command.

characteristic_polynomial.note: Characteristic polynomial det(λI - A); I is LinearAlgebra UniformScaling (auto-sized).

expand_neighbor_sum.note: Handler-built (JuliaBuildMixin): expands a nearest-neighbor bond sum on a 1D chain (open/periodic) into the explicit sum of per-site operator terms.
